title: Ultra-Detailed Studio Portrait
desc: Creates photorealistic 8K portrait photography with natural studio lighting.
prompt: A cinematic studio portrait of [Subject], soft box lighting, 85mm lens, depth of field, sharp focus on eyes, ultra-realistic skin texture, 8k resolution, photorealistic render --ar 16:9 --v 6.0

title: Viral Social Media Post Creator
desc: Writes high-converting hooks and structured posts for LinkedIn & Twitter.
prompt: Act as a viral content strategist. Write a 5-part social media post about [Topic]. Start with a powerful hook line to stop scrolling, use short scannable sentences, add 3 actionable tips, and finish with a strong call-to-action.

title: ATS-Optimized Resume Tailor
desc: Customizes your bullet points and executive summary to match any target job description.
prompt: Act as a professional career coach. Tailor my resume bullet points for a [Target Job Title] role. Rewrite these accomplishments to sound impact-driven using strong action verbs, numbers, and key skills required for this position: [Paste Experience]

title: SEO Article & Outline Generator
desc: Creates complete blog posts structured to rank high on Google search.
prompt: Act as an SEO expert. Write an engaging 1000-word article on [Insert Keyword/Topic]. Include an optimized Meta Description, H1 Title, H2/H3 Subheadings, key bullet points, and a concluding Summary with FAQ section.

title: B2B Sales Outreach Email
desc: Short, personalized 4-sentence email designed for high response rates.
prompt: Write a concise cold outreach email offering [Your Service/Product] to a [Prospect's Title] in [Prospect's Industry]. Make it personal, highlight one major pain-point solution, and end with a low-friction meeting request.

title: Code Debugger & Optimizer
desc: Detects errors in your code, fixes bugs, and explains the solution clearly.
prompt: Act as a Senior Full-Stack Software Engineer. Analyze the following code snippet for bugs, performance issues, and best practices. Provide the corrected code and briefly explain what changes were made: [Paste Code]

title: Full-Stack Bug Fixer & Code Reviewer
desc: Analyze messy code snippets, find performance bottlenecks, and output clean, production-ready code with explanations.
prompt:
Act as an expert Senior Full-Stack Engineer. Review the following code for security vulnerabilities, memory leaks, and performance bottlenecks. Provide a refactored, clean, and optimized version along with a brief explanation of what was fixed:

[Insert your code here]

title: High-Converting Viral Ad Copywriter
desc: Generate high-CTR marketing hooks and ad copy frameworks (AIDA/PAS) for social media campaigns.
prompt: Act as a world-class Direct Response Copywriter. Write 5 high-converting ad hooks and a full-length ad copy using the PAS (Problem-Agitate-Solution) framework for the following product/service. Target Audience: [Insert audience]. Product details: [Insert details]

title: SEO Optimized Blog Post Outliner
desc: Create comprehensive, keyword-rich article outlines with H2/H3 headings and intent matching.
prompt: Act as an expert SEO Content Strategist. Create a detailed, click-worthy blog post outline for the target keyword '[Insert Keyword]'. Include suggested H2 and H3 headings, search intent breakdown, estimated word count per section, and internal linking ideas.

title: Cinematic Midjourney v6 Photo Generator
desc: Craft hyper-realistic, cinematic portrait and landscape prompts with advanced camera parameters.
prompt: A cinematic, ultra-realistic portrait of [Subject], dramatic volumetric studio lighting, moody atmosphere, shot on 35mm lens, f/1.8 aperture, photorealistic skin texture, highly detailed --ar 16:9 --v 6.0 --style raw

title: Full-Stack Code Reviewer & Optimizer
desc: Identify security flaws, memory leaks, and performance bottlenecks in any code snippet.
prompt:
Act as a Principal Software Engineer. Review the following [Language/Framework] code for security vulnerabilities, edge-case bugs, time/space complexity, and readability. Provide a refactored, production-ready version along with bullet-point explanations of each improvement:

[Paste Code Here]

title: SQL Query Builder & Performance Tuner
desc: Generate optimized SQL queries and indexing recommendations from plain English.
prompt: Act as a Senior Database Administrator. Write an optimized [PostgreSQL/MySQL] query to achieve the following goal: [Describe Goal]. Assume these table schemas: [Insert Schema]. Also recommend specific database indexes to ensure fast execution on millions of rows.

title: React + Tailwind Component Generator
desc: Build responsive, accessible React components styled with Tailwind CSS.
prompt: Create a modern, fully responsive React functional component using Tailwind CSS for a [Component Name, e.g., Pricing Table / Dashboard Card]. Ensure dark mode support (`dark:` classes), keyboard accessibility, clean state management with hooks, and zero external UI library dependencies.

title: Viral YouTube Hook & Script Architect
desc: Craft high-retention YouTube video intros and structured scripts that keep viewers watching.
prompt: Act as a YouTube retention strategist. Write a high-energy, curiosity-driven 45-second hook and a structured 5-minute script outline for a video titled '[Video Title]' aimed at [Target Audience]. Avoid clichés and include visual B-roll cues in brackets.

title: Complex Topic Simplifier (Feynman Technique)
desc: Break down difficult technical or academic concepts into crystal-clear explanations.
prompt: Explain [Complex Topic] using the Feynman Technique. First, explain it in simple language a 12-year-old could understand using a real-world analogy. Second, highlight the 3 most common misconceptions. Finally, provide a concise summary for an industry professional.

title: Executive Article & Newsletter Polisher
desc: Transform rough notes into a punchy, authoritative Substack or LinkedIn newsletter.
prompt:
Act as a senior editor. Rewrite the following rough draft into an engaging, punchy newsletter edition. Use short paragraphs, bold key takeaways, strong transitions, and end with a thought-provoking question to spark reader replies:

[Paste Rough Draft]

title: High-Converting Cold Email Sequence
desc: Generate a 3-step B2B cold outreach email sequence that gets replies without sounding spammy.
prompt: Write a 3-email B2B cold outreach sequence targeting [Job Title] at [Company Type] to pitch [Product/Service]. Email 1 should focus on a specific pain point and be under 100 words. Email 2 (3 days later) should share a quick case study/metric. Email 3 (7 days later) should be a polite breakup email.

title: SEO Content Cluster & Pillar Strategy
desc: Plan a complete topical authority content map around any seed keyword.
prompt: Act as an SEO Director. Build a topical authority content cluster for the main niche '[Niche/Keyword]'. Provide 1 comprehensive Pillar Page topic and 10 supporting long-tail blog post titles, including search intent (Informational/Commercial) and primary target keywords for each.

title: Photorealistic Studio Product Photography
desc: Generate commercial-grade studio product shots in Midjourney v6.
prompt: Commercial studio product photography of [Product Name, e.g., matte black wireless headphones] resting on a textured dark slate podium, dramatic rim lighting, subtle volumetric mist, water droplets, shot on Hasselblad H6D-100c, 85mm macro lens, f/2.8, ultra-detailed, photorealistic --ar 4:5 --v 6.0 --style raw

title: 3D Isometric Tech App Icon
desc: Create sleek, modern 3D glassmorphism icons for websites and mobile apps.
prompt: 3D isometric icon of [Object, e.g., a glowing rocket / AI brain chip], frosted glassmorphism texture with vibrant indigo and neon cyan gradient accents, soft ambient occlusion shadows, floating over a clean dark slate background, Cinema 4D, Octane render, minimalist UI asset --ar 1:1 --v 6.0

title: SaaS Pricing & Monetization Strategist
desc: Design profitable Free, Pro, and Enterprise pricing tiers for digital products.
prompt: Act as a SaaS monetization consultant. Design a 3-tier pricing structure (Free, Pro, Business) for [Product Description] targeting [Target Market]. Specify feature gates, usage limits, psychological anchoring tactics, and recommended monthly/annual pricing.

title: Lean Startup One-Page Business Plan
desc: Validate a new business or app idea using the Lean Canvas framework.
prompt: Create a Lean Canvas business model for [Business/App Idea]. Clearly define: 1) Top 3 Customer Problems, 2) Unique Value Proposition, 3) Unfair Advantage, 4) Customer Segments, 5) Acquisition Channels, 6) Revenue Streams, and 7) Key Metrics to track in the first 90 days.

title: ATS-Optimized Resume Bullet Rewriter
desc: Turn weak job descriptions into quantifiable, impact-driven resume achievements.
prompt:
Act as an Executive Tech Recruiter. Rewrite the following resume bullet points using the Google XYZ formula (Accomplished [X] as measured by [Y], by doing [Z]). Incorporate strong action verbs and relevant ATS keywords for a [Target Role] position:

[Paste Current Bullets]

title: Mock Technical & Behavioral Interviewer
desc: Practice tough interview questions with real-time feedback and sample answers.
prompt: Act as a Hiring Manager interviewing me for a [Job Title] role at a top company. Ask me 1 challenging behavioral or technical question at a time. Wait for my response, grade my answer out of 10 using the STAR method, give specific feedback, and then ask the next question.
